name: Annotations Tool API
description: Exposes annotation context as Tool API plugins for on-demand retrieval by function-calling AI agents.
project_description: Annotations Tool API exposes the assembled annotation context as drupal/tool Tool plugins so function-calling AI agents can retrieve site documentation on demand. It provides two read tools: annotations_read (Get Annotations) returns a target's annotation documentation as markdown, and a tool to list the configured annotation targets. Both require the tool and tool_ai_connector modules and gate access on view annotations context / administer annotations.
